payload.comment: All deterministic checks pass across ingestion, preprocessing, profiling, and data_profile. Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) are arithmetically verified from per-class counts in every split. Provenance (SHA-256 per split + archive MD5) is present. Zero duplicates, zero blank images, 100% profiled. Channel statistics are plausible for H&E. The data_profile correctly identifies cross-center domain shift, test-set class-distribution skew, and label-boundary ambiguities as dataset-inherent risks. llm_issues: Narrative test-set imbalance cited as ≈3.64 in profiling and data_profile text; actual max/min from class_counts is 1338/339 ≈ 3.95 (3.64 corresponds to 1233/339). Text-only; structured data is correct.
data_profile artefact appears truncated (ends with '…'); fields beyond the visible portion (e.g., full ambiguity_note, any additional structured fields) could not be independently verified.
Non-standard LLM model identifier 'qwen3.8' used as source across all stages; confirm it resolves to the intended Ollama model if LLM-assisted steps follow.

28×28×3 resolution is the official MedMNIST format but is a fundamental discriminative ceiling for H&E histopathology; experiment design should explicitly acknowledge this limitation in expected-performance framing.
